title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
summary: Alexey Dosovitskiy and coauthors submitted 'An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale' on October 22, 2020. The paper describes applying a pure Transformer directly to sequences of image patches and names the resulting model Vision Transformer (ViT).
significance: A documented research-publication milestone for Vision Transformer (ViT) as a Transformer-based image-classification model.

verification.note: The original arXiv record identifies the authors, October 22 2020 submission date, and the paper's description of a pure Transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches, naming Vision Transformer (ViT). Google Research independently lists the same work and authors as an ICLR 2021 publication. The day-precision date is attached only to the arXiv submission milestone and is not asserted as a universal system-birth date. No geography, institutional affiliation, ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.
